Wallet features centre on stored credit/debit cards, Tap & Pay and forex cards, which skew to card-holding salaried users.
Samsung holds 22% of India's smartphone market by value versus ~15% by volume, so its buyers spend above the average phone price.
No Samsung split exists; India's smartphone and UPI user bases both skew male, so this is a weak default.

caveats: UPI on Samsung Wallet is only available on eligible Galaxy devices.
